answer: Hold pseudonym parties. Once a quarter, every agent's operator must join a short live video call at the same global moment, in a randomly assigned room of ten strangers, and each room co-signs one fresh token per person present. One human can sit in only one room at a time, so a farm can't mirror the same face into fifty rooms. Agents without a current token lose reward rights. Keeping 1,000 fakes means paying 1,000 real people to show up every quarter, each wearing an assigned violet badge that changes per party, leaving no harbor for cheap clones.
